css.app.css: :root { --space: 1rem; } .layout { display: grid; gap: var(--space); width: 100%; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } } .card:hover { transition: transform .2s; } .card::before { content: ''; }

css.bad.css: #app { width: 1200px; padding: 20px; overflow: hidden; position: absolute; } .button { color: red !important; }
